messages:
emily: Friday quick sync 1) prepping joint marketplace bump: H100 partner images, H200 fallback lanes, MI300 pilot, Gaudi SI handoff. Need final owner list and clear gating criteria.

noah: I'll take H100 owner. Immediate risk: partner image includes a custom kernel module that fails our notarization check. Partner says it's needed for low-latency DMA. We need attestation or a vetted binary. Filed PART-889.

zara: Runtime update: MI300 quantized path is stable in low-latency tests but shows higher token variance on long-context chat (seq > 4096). SI wants a deterministic perf run prior to any marketplace push.

peter: Ops note: H200 capacity ok as fallback. But autoscaler config currently limits burst to 12 nodes; for expected initial load we want 18. I can increase but need approval window for cost. Also B200 SKU has been validated for burst mode.

mica: Legal checks: partner IP attestation pending for both H100 module and MI300 model assets. We can allow SI-only pilots with an SI addendum signed. Also require a short embargo clause for joint comms.

emily: Owners & gating: noah=H100 signature & vendor attestation; zara=MI300 deterministic perf runs + SI validation; peter=capacity/fallback & autoscale tweak; mica=legal attestation + SI addendum. Marketing wants a 10-day heads-up and embargo language. Proposed soft date: 2024-08-02 (SI-only), GA target: 2024-08-16. Any redlines?

noah: I'll escalate binary notarization to partner eng now. If they can't provide signed module within 72h, fallback is to ship H100 image with module disabled and a "hardware acceleration disabled" note in partner docs.

zara: Deterministic perf run snippet for SI teams:
```
export RW_ENV=si-canary
./bench --model mi300-quant --seq 4096 --batch 2 --seed 1234 --repeat 5 > mi300-determinism.log
# attach log and run id to PART-900 when filing
```

peter: I'll propose autoscale change: min=4, max=24, burst=18 for the marketplace route. Scheduling a 30m maintenance window Sunday 02:00-02:30 PT to roll config and monitor costs.

mica: Sending SI addendum template to partner legal now. If they sign within 5 business days we can proceed with SI-only. Also need to confirm data processing terms for telemetry.

announce-bot: Staging publish scheduled: `marketplace/partner-batch-aug-2024` 1) state: queued waiting on PART-889 and PART-900 signoffs 1) 2024-07-22T09:00:00Z

emily: Ok1) short checklist recap (1-line each)
- noah: cosign & module attestation or safe-disable plan
- zara: deterministic MI300 perf + SI approval
- peter: autoscale change window + capacity confirmation
- mica: legal attestation + SI addendum signed

emily: Reconvene Mon 10am PT unless blockers surface. Please post quick updates in this thread only. :rocket:
